row: KTLA 5 in Los Angeles covers breaking news, weather and traffic for L.A., Orange, Riverside, San Bernardino and Ventura counties. Serving Southern California since 1947. Watch KTLA for free with the KTLA+ app for Roku, Fire TV, Apple TV and Samsung Smart TV's, and on YouTube TV.
